datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (monthly) field assessments across Uganda to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Results were spatially mapped by administrative unit and compiled into geographic datasets (GeoJSON/KML) for multiple months in 2019, representing near-term projections of food insecurity phases.
